display_name: NIS2 Entity Scope Classifier (Essential / Important / Out-of-Scope)
purpose: Classify an entity as Essential, Important, or Out-of-Scope under NIS2 Directive 2022/2555 Annex I and II, applying sector codes, employee/turnover size thresholds, and automatic-essential carve-outs (DNS providers, qualified trust service providers, public electronic communications networks). Feeds the Art. 21 gap checker (art-142). NIS2 entity classification active October 2024; annual registration window January–June each year.
